SELECT
    schemaname AS esquema,
    relname AS tabla,
    n_live_tup::bigint AS registros_estimados
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
WHERE schemaname = 'public'
  AND relname IN (
      'clientes',
      'ventas',
      'productos',
      'lotes_produccion',
      'materias_primas',
      'control_calidad',
      'gastos'
  )
ORDER BY relname;
